name: Najaf
title: Najaf
subtitle: Level 1
summary: Three districts around a crossroads: a ruined city, an oil refinery and the desert outskirts. Each has a place you can take as your base.
briefing: You start at the crossroads. Pick a base: the police station (city, north-west), the truck stop (outskirts, south-west) or the control building (refinery, east).
Clear its defenders and step inside. It becomes your base and the clock starts.
Fetch crates and build upgrades at the marked spots. Every district has its own construction (walls), ammunition, medical and armour crate, not far from its base.
Fuel tanks explode when a rocket hits them. Keep your distance.

goals.claim: Clear a base: police station (city), truck stop (outskirts) or control building (refinery)
goals.fetch: Fetch a crate and build an upgrade at a marked spot in your base
